"""Run an isolated exact-source TestPilot regression course; no installs or services."""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
INPUT = ROOT / "course-input.json"
data = json.loads(INPUT.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def identity(body):
    return {
        "bytes": len(body),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),
        "git_blob": hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(body)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + body).hexdigest(),
    }


def write_new(path, body):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(body)


def projection(name):
    target = ROOT / name
    target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    records = []
    for file in data["files"]:
        body = file["content"].encode("utf-8")
        found = identity(body)
        if found["bytes"] != file["bytes"] or found["git_blob"] != file["git_blob"]:
            raise RuntimeError("source identity mismatch: " + file["path"])
        if file["mode"] != "100644" or file["type"] != "blob":
            raise RuntimeError("unexpected source mode/type: " + file["path"])
        write_new(target / file["path"], body)
        records.append({"path": file["path"], **found})
    extra = data["new_test"]
    body = extra["content"].encode("utf-8")
    write_new(target / extra["path"], body)
    records.append({"path": extra["path"], **identity(body)})
    return target, records


def check_projection(target, records):
    return [{"path": item["path"], "matches": identity((target / item["path"]).read_bytes()) ==
             {key: item[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256", "git_blob")}} for item in records]


def run(target, name, tests, optimized=False):
    run_dir = ROOT / name
    run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
           if not key.startswith(("GIT_", "PYTHON", "PYTEST_"))}
    supplied_env = {
        "PYTHONPATH": str(target), "PYTHONNOUSERSITE": "1",
        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "PYTHONHASHSEED": "0",
        "PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD": "1",
        "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM": "1", "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": os.devnull,
    }
    env.update(supplied_env)
    command = [sys.executable, *(["-O"] if optimized else []), "-B", "-m", "pytest",
               "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "--basetemp", str(run_dir / "tmp"),
               "--junitxml", str(run_dir / "junit.xml"), *tests]
    start = time.monotonic()
    completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=target, env=env, capture_output=True, timeout=240)
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
    write_new(run_dir / "stdout.txt", completed.stdout)
    write_new(run_dir / "stderr.txt", completed.stderr)
    cases = []
    for case in ET.parse(run_dir / "junit.xml").iter("testcase"):
        outcome = "pass"
        if case.find("failure") is not None:
            outcome = "failure"
        elif case.find("error") is not None:
            outcome = "error"
        elif case.find("skipped") is not None:
            outcome = "skip"
        cases.append({"classname": case.get("classname"), "name": case.get("name"), "outcome": outcome})
    result = {
        "command": command, "cwd": str(target), "supplied_environment": supplied_env,
        "exit_code": completed.returncode, "duration_seconds": elapsed,
        "stdout": identity(completed.stdout), "stderr": identity(completed.stderr),
        "junit": identity((run_dir / "junit.xml").read_bytes()),
        "counts": {kind: sum(case["outcome"] == kind for case in cases)
                   for kind in ("pass", "failure", "error", "skip")},
        "cases": cases,
    }
    write_new(run_dir / "receipt.json", (json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))
    print(json.dumps({"run": name, "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
                      "counts": result["counts"], "duration_seconds": elapsed}), flush=True)
    return result


target, source_records = projection("original-projection")
runs = [
    run(target, "original-new-normal", [data["new_test"]["path"]]),
    run(target, "original-new-optimized", [data["new_test"]["path"]], optimized=True),
    run(target, "original-existing-normal", data["existing_tests"]),
]
preserved = check_projection(target, source_records)
receipt = {
    "repository": data["repository"], "commit": data["commit"], "tree": data["tree"],
    "environment": {"python": sys.version, "executable": sys.executable,
                    "platform": platform.platform(), "uid": os.getuid()},
    "input": identity(INPUT.read_bytes()), "receiver": identity(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
    "projection": str(target), "source_files": source_records, "runs": runs,
    "source_preserved": preserved,
}
write_new(ROOT / "original-course.json", (json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))
assert all(item["matches"] for item in preserved), "source projection was changed"
assert [run["exit_code"] for run in runs] == [1, 1, 0], "unexpected course outcome; inspect receipts"
assert runs[0]["counts"] == runs[1]["counts"] == {
    "pass": 7, "failure": 6, "error": 0, "skip": 0
}, "unexpected original negative/control counts"
print("Original negative controls and existing regression course preserved.", flush=True)
